Permission from the king to build a synagogue (13 years after the 1320 settlement); organized community
About 4000 Spanish Jewish refugees crossed the border near Castelo de Vide after the 1492 expulsion; refugee count not treated as resident population
Approximately 4000 Jews said to have settled in the town after 1492 expulsion from Spain; a judiaria already existed in the 14th century; refugee estimate not resident count
Written documents attest to a Jewish community and Jewish quarter throughout the 14th and 15th centuries; late-14th-century synagogue; year is midpoint of the 14th-15th centuries range (approx)
After the 1496 expulsion/conversion decree many Jewish families remained and converted to Christianity
Marranos continued using the synagogue as sanctuary and school until the mid 16th century
Garcia de Orta born in Castelo de Vide probably 1501 to Jewish parents from Valencia de Alcantara who fled in 1492; family forcibly converted 1497
Catarina de Orta (sister of Garcia de Orta) burned in Goa for Judaism 25 Oct 1569; Garcia posthumously convicted 1580; indicates crypto-Jewish New Christian family of the town
